title: My Brother Drained $190K From My House During Cancer. So I Watched Him Scrub Grease Traps
description: After 28 years on a hospital cafeteria line, I paid off my bungalow, then cancer hit and my brother Mark used a fake power of attorney to drain $190,000 into his failing catering hall. I proved the notary stamp was fake, voided the mortgage, and now he scrubs grease traps in a jacket that says 'Garnished My Equity.' #FamilyBetrayal #RevengeStory #Karma
thumb_text: HE STOLE $190K. NOW HE SCRUBS GREASE TRAPS.
pinned_comment: If your brother drained $190,000 from your paid off house during cancer and left you with a $4,700 meal credit, what would you have done the day that foreclosure notice arrived? Tell me your story in the comments.
